newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan in 34,000T Canada wheat contract - traders.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan in 34,000T Canada wheat contract - traders.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association said on Friday it had entered a contract for shipment of 34,000 tonnes of Canada sprint wheat in a private negotiation.
The wheat was bought at US$238 per tonne and the shipment was slated for delivery from a Canadian port in late December, a flour mills association official said by telephone.
The official declined to give further details.
Traders said the flour association would place tenders soon for two further shipments totaling 72,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
Those shipments would be slated for delivery from December 15 and December 30, they said.
